name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
description: A central scheme supporting India's traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 family-based trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, goldsmiths, cobblers, tailors, and others), providing formal recognition, skill training, toolkit support, and access to collateral-free credit.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma recognition certificate and ID card; free basic skill training (5-7 days, 40 hours) with a stipend of Rs. 500/day; toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000 via e-RUPI voucher; collateral-free loans up to Rs. 3 lakh at just 5% interest, disbursed in stages (Rs. 1 lakh first tranche, up to Rs. 2 lakh second tranche).
eligibility: Applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the 18 recognised trades
Minimum age 18 years; no minimum years of practice required, self-declaration with photo evidence suffices
Only one member per family can enroll
Family must not have availed a similar credit-based subsidy (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, MUDRA) in the last 5 years
Government employees and their families are not eligible
documents_required: Trade self-declaration with photo evidence, verified by the local panchayat/ULB
how_to_apply: Register online at pmvishwakarma.gov.in with mobile number and Aadhaar e-KYC, or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Complete the mandatory basic training before claiming the toolkit grant or applying for the loan.
